reviews.title: Good affordable monitor native 16:9 ratio 240hz
reviews.comment: i love this monitor. The native resolution is 16:9  BUT I use my Nvidia graphics card to put a custom 21:9 resolution at 240hz on it. there is some black space at the top and bottom of the screen due to this but since monitors with that 21:9 ratio and hz are way more expensive im just doing it that way to save money. this monitor doesnt have 4k but my graphics card wont support 4k so i am not complaining. the quality is fine, regular HD, nothing crazy. The high frame rate is what i wanted this supports 241 fps.

reviews.title: Great upgrade for gaming
reviews.comment: This monitor is replacing a smaller one the was 10 years old. The upgraded computer I have needed a faster monitor for gaming.  Just plug and play. I really like that it powers on when I turn on my computer.  Brilliant colors with very sharp images and smooth transitions. The 32 inch curved screen seems to lessen eye fatigue and much more enjoyable than the flat 27 inch I had before.
reviews.author: Floyd Dennard

reviews.title: Very Good Monitor, Fantastic at this Price
reviews.comment: I bought one and will be buying another.  I am using this to replace two 24 ASUS I had for a while and I wanted something a bit bigger for my main system and they have great value.  These aren't bad.  They are actually pretty good. I hooked it up to a mini-mac and it was ok.  It automatically sets at highest resolution and the 240 Hz refresh rate is a big attraction.  I think, if you were looking to get a gift to a gamer, even though this isn't crystal, this would a great gift on a budget.  The control on the back of the monitor is easy to use. The stand is solid but there is no left right, up down control so if you need that, this isn't the monitor for you.  For me, 32 is about as big as you want to get if you are sitting right in front of it (of course, I will have two). I watched a digital video (Amazing Spider Man) via Apple TV and Compared it to my other system with the 24s on them (a blu-ray) and honestly, the video via this monitor was slightly better. The subtitles were definitely crispier.  I was looking at the blacks on each and I saw some distinctiveness.  I have an OLED TV so I am spoiled there but being at your computer.. not bad, not bad at all.  Obviously there are way better high end monitor, but you are going to spend BUT for this price... fantastic.  Not a 5 star review because it isn't one of those but the highest review I will give a monitor of this price and size.  Get yourself one.
reviews.author: E. Smith

reviews.title: Extremely happy with these monitors!
reviews.comment: I love my two Sansui 32" curved monitors. I work primarily from home and the performance of these monitors is excellent. I also tend to watch quite a bit of online streaming with them and the picture quality is top notch. These are lower price point monitors that honestly should be going for a lot more. My dad like mine so much he bought four for his stock market trade station.
